285139779.description:
Smoking Pipe and Collectible Lot - 6 Pieces
Missouri Meerschaum, Tobacciana & Glassware
Vintage collection of five authentic Missouri Meerschaum smoking pipes crafted in Washington, Missouri, alongside a decorative glass bell. Renowned as the oldest and largest corn cob pipe maker in the world since 1869, Missouri Meerschaum produces iconic, cool-smoking American pipes with porous natural cob and hardwood bowls.
Items Included:
2 Missouri Meerschaum natural finish corn cob pipes with black plastic stems
2 Missouri Meerschaum yellow-lacquered corn cob pipes with amber-colored stems
1 Missouri Meerschaum dark stained hardwood pipe with black plastic stem
1 clear glass bell with etched horizontal rings and interior chain clapper (faceted handle detached)
Condition:
Pipes appear unsmoked with clean interior bowls and intact maker stickers on bases. Minor natural variation and surface marks on cobs and wooden shanks. Glass bell has a detached faceted glass handle with dried adhesive residue visible at the top mount; clapper chain intact.
